entries.title: Rain World
entries.definitive_edition: Rain World on Windows PC with Downpour and The Watcher

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with both DLC packs installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with complete expansion content and modding support.

primary.version: Current PC release plus Downpour and The Watcher
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archival version because it covers the base game, the Rain World Remix/modding/accessibility update path, the Downpour expansion, and the later The Watcher expansion while preserving PC capture/settings flexibility. Console versions now provide broad access to the same major DLC line, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Rain World on Steam for Windows PC and install both paid expansions: Rain World: Downpour and Rain World: The Watcher. Use the current patched build before beginning a full archive run.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; completeness depends on installing both paid DLC packs and using the current patched build.
